name: io.github.aileron-sh/aileron
title: Aileron Journal
description: Read-only queries over Aileron audit journals: verify integrity, search recorded tool calls

packageArguments.description: Runs the read-only journal server. Aileron's other subcommands are CLI tools, not MCP servers.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: Directory holding the journals to expose. Paths are confined to it, so nothing outside can be read.
